summary: Make plan.json update mandatory and prominent in plan-enhancer post-approval steps. Previously the plan.json update was a sub-bullet that got skipped; now it is a separate numbered step with explicit instructions.

Remove embedded web dashboard (scripts/ultra-dashboard/); extract tmux layout daemon to standalone scripts/tmux-layout-daemon.js. Delete ensure-dashboard and tmux-team-grid skills. Remove all HTTP API calls from PM agent. Dashboard is now an optional standalone app (ultra-claude-web).

migration.precondition: Project has been initialized with Ultra Claude (any version with dashboard references)
actions: The ensure-dashboard and tmux-team-grid skills no longer exist — remove any references to them
Dashboard PID, registry, and projects files under ~/.claude/ultra/ are no longer used and can be safely deleted: dashboard.pid, dashboard-registry.json, dashboard-projects.json
Re-run /uc:setup to update environment checks (dashboard check removed)
migration.conflicts: Any custom scripts that curl localhost:3847 or reference the old dashboard API will need to be updated.

summary: Add session tracking and normalized account identity. SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks establish per-session account mapping, eliminating the multi-account race condition in statusline. Account IDs are slugified emails (e.g. dawid-duniec-at-axb-co). Move statusline.sh from scripts/ultra-dashboard/ to scripts/. Add shared scripts/lib.sh with slugifyEmail utility. usage-status.json now keyed by account_id instead of email. Remove claude auth status calls from statusline and dashboard API.

migration.precondition: Ultra Claude setup has been run (statusline configured)
actions: Re-run /uc:setup to install session hooks, lib.sh symlink, and update statusline symlink to new source path
The ~/.claude/ultra/statusline-auth/ directory is deprecated and can be safely removed
migration.conflicts: Custom scripts reading usage-status.json with email keys will need to switch to account_id keys. Dashboard API handles both formats during transition.

summary: Improve extra usage prompt in plan execution to clearly explain both options and add cost tip about planning during the day and executing overnight.

Consolidate plan execution status to single plan.json at plan root. Eliminate status/ directory and per-task status/teams/task-N.json files. Tasks are now embedded in plan.json as an array. Standardize status values: plan (pending/in_progress/completed), task (pending/in_progress/completed/failed), member (active/completed/failed). Create references/plan-status-format.md as single source of truth. Update PM agent, plan-enhancer, plan-status-sync, roadmap, dashboard code, and all views. Plan-enhancer now populates tasks array on approval. Dashboard has legacy fallback for old status/ paths and old status values.

migration.precondition: Project has documentation/plans/*/status/plan.json or status/teams/ files
actions: For each plan directory: if status/plan.json exists, move it to plan.json at plan root. If status/events.json exists, move it to events.json at plan root.
If status/teams/task-*.json files exist, merge their data into the plan.json tasks array, then remove the status/ directory
Run /uc:plan-status-sync to reconcile all plans with the new format
migration.conflicts: Custom scripts reading status/plan.json or status/teams/ need path updates. Dashboard code has legacy fallback so existing plans will still render.

summary: Rename status/project.json to status/plan.json across codebase. Fix plan status gaps: plan-enhancer now creates plan.json at scaffold (draft) and updates it on approval. Rename readPlanProject to readPlanStatus in dashboard. Add explicit stub/draft/approved status values to dashboard statusClass. Remove incorrect gitignore claim — plan.json and events.json should be committed, only teams/ is ephemeral.

actions: If .gitignore contains a rule ignoring status/ under documentation/plans/, remove it — the entire status/ directory should be tracked.
migration.conflicts: If project.json was referenced in custom scripts or hooks, update those references to plan.json

summary: Replace PM's unreliable self-polling monitoring loop with CronCreate-based heartbeat. Cron fires every 5 minutes, waking PM to update dashboard timers and check usage limits. Fixes issue where PM would forget to poll between incoming messages.
Fix statusline setup: add required 'type: command' to statusLine config in setup skill, fix validation check to match exact expected command path instead of substring match on repo path.

Add Plan Stub Bootstrap rule to roadmap skill. Roadmap now creates status/project.json alongside each stub README so the dashboard daemon discovers plans immediately without requiring a separate plan-status-sync run.

Add global file migration step to /uc:update. Detects files at old ~/.claude/ paths and moves them to ~/.claude/ultra/, re-creates statusline symlink, and updates settings.json command. Handles both fresh and stale-duplicate cases. Changelog read now checks both old and new marker locations for backwards compatibility.

Move global Ultra Claude runtime files from ~/.claude/ to ~/.claude/ultra/ — uc-setup.json, statusline.sh, statusline-auth/, dashboard.pid, usage-status.json, dashboard-projects.json, dashboard-registry.json. Cleans up Claude Code's config directory by namespacing all Ultra Claude state under ~/.claude/ultra/. Updated all runtime scripts, skill docs, agent docs, and references.

Restore reviewer early-spawn with executor. Reviewer has unique standards/architecture context and applies it continuously: plan feedback, early file reading, formal review. Only tester remains lazy-spawned after implementation complete. Updated orchestration, spawn prompts, agent workflows, and PM tracking.

Make backlog user-initiated only. Remove auto-add backlog instructions from 5 skills (plan-execution, feature-mode, discovery-mode, debug-mode, doc-code-verification). Add mid-execution gap handling — lead amends plan and builds small gaps instead of deferring. Add Amendments section to completion summary template.
Update help skill descriptions for plan-execution (lazy-spawn, no pipeline) and project-manager (parallel timing, no stall detection).

Rewrite Lead orchestration for lazy-spawn, no pipeline, and parallel stage tracking. Executor spawns alone at task start; reviewer/tester lazy-spawned on 'implementation complete'. Pipeline spawning removed entirely — tasks only spawn when all deps complete. New STAGE-DONE message for independent review/test timing. Communication protocol updated.

Update spawn prompts and phase-1 setup for lazy-spawn and no pipeline. Executor spawns alone with deferred reviewer/tester. Reviewer/tester prompts rewritten for hot-start. PM spawn prompt updated with new message types. Cost estimate reduced from 150K to 100K per task. Pipeline mode removed.

Update PM for lazy-spawn, parallel timing, and no pipeline. Team JSON now starts with executor only; reviewer/tester added via SPAWNED-REVIEWER/SPAWNED-TESTER events. Review and testing tracked as parallel stages with independent timers via STAGE-DONE. Removed watchdog references, stall detection, rate-limit detection, and pipeline events.

Update executor for lazy-spawn and no pipeline. Remove reviewer plan feedback, progress updates to reviewer, and pipeline gate. Add per-gate PASS/FAIL reporting to Lead for parallel review/test timing. Executor now waits for Lead to confirm reviewer/tester spawn before driving review/test.
Rewrite tester workflow for hot-start (lazy-spawn prep). Tester now spawns when code is ready, reads context immediately, and starts testing without a waiting phase.

Rewrite reviewer workflow for hot-start (lazy-spawn prep). Remove While Waiting, Plan Review, and Early Reading phases. Reviewer now spawns when code is ready and starts reviewing immediately. Technology research happens during formal review instead of early reading.

Add structured PASS template for code reviewer. PASS verdicts now include per-category checks ([PATTERN], [ARCHITECTURE], [QUALITY], [DOCS], [COMPLETENESS]) with file:line references and knowledge agent citations, matching the rigor of FAIL verdicts.

Remove watchdog stall/rate-limit detection from dashboard. File-modification-based stall detection produced false positives (3700+ lines of noise per execution). PM monitors agents directly via SendMessage. Usage data read directly from usage-status.json.

Add usage limit management for plan execution. Asks 'Enable extra usage?' before spawning teams. When declined, PM monitors 5-hour rate limit and triggers PAUSE at 90% (with checkpoint), RESUME after reset. Supports multiple pause/resume cycles across 5-hour windows. Dashboard watchdog independently tracks usage threshold.

Agent self-labeling for faster tmux pane naming. Agents now label their own panes on startup via TASK_ID/ROLE variables instead of sending PANE messages to PM. Eliminates PM bottleneck when multiple agents spawn simultaneously. PM retains verification-and-repair role.
Add /uc:tech-research invocation to migrate Standards Explore agents so coding standards are grounded in external best practices via Ref.tools, not just codebase patterns.

Rename init-project to migrate. Add version-aware project migration with CHANGELOG.json, per-project .claude/ultra/version.json marker, and structured migration registry. Consolidate .claude/ config files to .claude/ultra/ namespace. Drop legacy .claude/system-test.md fallbacks. Replace VERSION_HISTORY.md with queryable JSON changelog.

migration.conflicts: Preserve user customizations — move files as-is, do not regenerate content.

summary: Disable caching on docs sidebar endpoint so navigation updates reflect immediately.
Fix docsify nested directory navigation — disable relativePath since sidebar uses absolute links.
Docs sidebar: recursive directory walking for technology/product sections — supports arbitrarily nested doc structures (e.g. architecture/backend/platform).

Rewrite architecture reference — narrative-driven template with ASCII diagram + walkthrough replacing table-heavy layout. Adds bold key terms, multiple path guidance, inline example, and risks for human-dependent processes.
Fix backlog API returning empty for projects registered via seeds (no plans). Now falls back to getProjectRoots() to resolve project root.
Init-project: make dashboard registration an explicit action step instead of a report bullet — always runs before summary.
Add `/uc:update` skill — pulls latest from git, clears plugin cache, force-restarts dashboard, shows changelog since last version, checks for project migration needs, updates setup marker.
Generic project discovery: remove hardcoded ~/Projects scan, add POST /api/register-project endpoint, init-project ensures dashboard and registers project on completion.
Ensure-dashboard skill: add "reset" argument to force-restart the dashboard process before ensuring it's running.
Add `/uc:ensure-dashboard` skill — user-invocable command to start dashboard, expose via Tailscale, and print URL. Wraps existing `references/ensure-dashboard.md`.

Unify versioning: drop semver, use date-based `YYYY.MM.DD-N` format everywhere (plugin.json, marketplace.json, VERSION_HISTORY.md). Show current version in dashboard header via `/api/version` endpoint.
Dashboard usage bar: green FRESH badge when rate-limit window has reset, alphabetical account sorting by org name.

Rename Tracker to Backlog — system renamed to `/uc:backlog`, directory `documentation/tracker/` → `documentation/backlog/`, category "External" → "Questions" (Q-NNN prefix), `technical-debt.json` → `debt.json`, new directional `blocks` field on items (blocked_by computed at read time), new block/unblock commands. Dashboard tab, API endpoint, route, all CSS/JS internals, and 7 cross-referencing skills updated. All internal names consistently renamed for clean codebase.

actions: Update CLAUDE.md — replace all references to /uc:tracker with /uc:backlog and tracker with backlog in the Ultra Claude section.
migration.conflicts: If documentation/backlog/ already exists, merge contents. If user has custom fields in tracker.json, preserve them during split.

summary: Split init-project skill into progressive-disclosure structure — SKILL.md reduced from 505 to 222 lines with 5 reference files (surveyor-prompts, claude-md-template, config-specs, explore-prompts, executor-prompts) loaded only at the phase that needs them. No behavior change, just better context efficiency.

Dashboard Docsify git change highlighting — new API endpoint `/api/docs/:project/git-changes` with diff parser and 10s cache, Docsify plugin with gutter annotations (amber marks for changed sections, full-height green stripe for new files), sidebar link coloring (amber changed, green new), file path display under page headings. Detects committed changes via `git diff`, untracked files via `git ls-files --others`, and staged new files.

Rewrite help skill as system knowledge base — 3-sentence descriptions for all 22 skills and 10 agents, system architecture overview, remove outdated HTML doc references and verbose examples. Init-project CLAUDE.md template adds mandatory bootstrap section that force-loads `/uc:help` and `/uc:docs-manager` at conversation start. Add Help Skill Sync rule to project CLAUDE.md — any skill/agent edit must update its 3-sentence description in help.

migration.precondition: CLAUDE.md does not exist, or exists but does not contain the "Bootstrap — MANDATORY" section heading.
actions: Add the mandatory Ultra Claude bootstrap section to CLAUDE.md. The section requires loading /uc:help and /uc:docs-manager at the start of every conversation. Read the claude-md-template reference for the exact content. Append to existing CLAUDE.md if present, create new if not. Never overwrite existing project-specific content.
migration.conflicts: If CLAUDE.md already has an Ultra Claude section, check if it has the bootstrap subsection. Add only what is missing.

summary: Add `/uc:tracker` skill — lightweight per-project backlog for ideas, dependencies, and bugs stored in `documentation/tracker.json`. New dashboard Tracker tab with multi-select filter pills (type + status), related item links, and priority indicators. Home page project cards show open tracker count. Replace old `documentation/dependencies/` system — docs-manager routes blockers/ideas/bugs to tracker instead of standalone documents, init-project migrates existing dependency docs. Agent awareness: plan-execution, debug-mode, feature-mode, and discovery-mode automatically add follow-up items to tracker.

actions: Extract open items from documentation/dependencies/*.md files (### headings with Priority and Blocks fields) into documentation/tracker/tracker.json with appropriate type/priority fields.
migration.conflicts: If documentation/tracker/ already exists, skip. Preserve documentation/dependencies/ originals in archive.

summary: Add Docsify as new default docs-format. Docs-manager enforces README.md in every category directory (directory-as-page convention), includes category README template with descriptions, and audits for missing READMEs. Init-project defaults to docsify. Dashboard sidebar makes top-level categories (Technology, Product, Dependencies) clickable links when README.md exists, removes duplicate "Overview" entries.

migration.conflicts: Never overwrite existing README.md files. Only create missing ones.

summary: Dashboard usage bar redesign: sort accounts alphabetically by email, swap layout (email left, limits right), fixed-width columns for aligned display, inline OVER LIMIT label replaces bar when exceeded, separator lines between accounts, responsive mobile layout with 2-row wrapping at 600px, improved inactive row readability (opacity 0.7).

PM tracks plan and task status in README. Plan status updates to "In Progress" on execution startup and "Completed" when operational report is written. Task checkboxes in plan template get checked off as tasks complete. New `/uc:plan-status-sync` skill to retroactively fix stale plan/task statuses from prior executions.

Centralize dashboard launch into shared `references/ensure-dashboard.md`. All skills (plan-execution, plan-enhancer, tmux-team-grid, roadmap) now read this single reference instead of inlining dashboard startup logic. Roadmap skill now ensures dashboard is running and prints a dashboard link after scaffolding plan stubs. PM agent uses shared reference for dashboard startup.

Statusline hardening: move auth cache from /tmp to ~/.claude/ultra/statusline-auth/ for persistence across reboots, add overwrite guard to prevent account-switch misidentification from replacing higher rate-limit usage with stale lower values, show data age on usage bar with stale indicator (>10m turns yellow), auto-cleanup auth cache files older than 24h. Update setup skill with auth cache directory check and creation step.

Dashboard overhaul: project-centric homepage with card grid, per-project detail page with Plans/Docs tabs, Docsify integration for browsing project documentation, multi-account rate limit usage bar, kanban task board for active plans. Auto-discover projects from ~/Projects. New statusline script for per-account usage tracking. Railway skill: add config-as-code (railway.toml) and Tailscale subnet router references. Plan execution: skip final gate for single-task plans. Setup skill: add statusline and dashboard checks/fixes.

Centralize tmux pane labeling in PM — fix bug where agents' self-label commands overwrote Lead's main-context label (tmux set-option -p without -t targets active pane, not calling pane). All agents now report $TMUX_PANE to PM on startup, PM labels everything. Add Bash to code-review and tech-knowledge agents. Remove all pane-diffing from Lead.

docs-manager: replace bare templates with reference guides. Each doc type now has a full reference (purpose, perspective, how-to, pitfalls, embedded template) instead of just a skeleton. Rename templates/ to references/. Product description template made fluid — free-form sections instead of rigid structure.

docs-manager: single authority for documentation templates. Move 5 templates to skills/docs-manager/templates/, create 4 new (product-description, testing, persona, research). Add Templates and Document Relationships sections. Mandatory doc gates in plan-enhancer Steps 2-3. Strip discovery-mode inline templates, allow technology docs. Add structural adherence verification to doc-code-verification-mode. All doc-producing skills now load docs-manager.
Railway skill: add default region to config schema, first-time setup flow, and config script (set-region/get-region commands). Defaults to eu-west (Netherlands) when not specified.

Roadmap skill: enforce full-stack plans — a feature must never be split across plans by architectural layer (no backend/frontend pairs). Strengthen sizing-framework heuristic #2 with anti-pattern examples, add constraint to SKILL.md, reinforce in stub template.

Replace tmux-team-grid post-hoc layout with incremental pane placement during spawning. Use `@agent-name` custom tmux options instead of pane titles (Claude Code overwrites titles). Two-pass column equalization. Left column fixed 70 cols, task columns distributed equally. tmux-team-grid becomes recovery-only tool. Remove PM pane-title-setting duties and pane IDs from SPAWNED messages. Add Lead plan review blocking gate to task-executor.
Remove `name` frontmatter field from all 19 skill files — field is not required by the plugin schema

Add `/uc:roadmap` skill — decomposes product into sequenced plan stubs with dependency graph. Creates stub plans (`Status: Stub`) that feature-mode consumes as starting points. Update feature-mode with Pre-Stage stub detection, plan-enhancer with stub-to-draft upgrade handling.

Fix skill schema warnings: add `name` field to all 18 skills, remove unsupported `context:` file-list frontmatter (replace with explicit read instructions in body), add PlanMode conflict prevention to plan-enhancer constraints, strengthen debug-mode constraints (no direct fixes), update docs to reflect new patterns

Fix stage skipping in debug-mode and plan-enhancer: add 3-point readiness check to Stage 1, remove "simple enough" escape hatch from Stage 2, make hypothesis generation a blocking AskUserQuestion gate, replace Stage 3 one-liner with concrete 4-point deliverable, add Stage Entry Check prerequisite to Stage 4, align persona with process discipline, enforce per-stage reference file reads

Migrate testing config from single `.claude/system-test.md` to multi-file `documentation/technology/testing/` directory (6 files: README, commands, infrastructure, security, agent-rules, final-gate). Update all agents (system-tester, task-tester), skills (init-project, plan-execution, debug-mode, docs-manager, help), and HTML docs to reference new location with graceful fallback to legacy path.

migration.conflicts: If documentation/technology/testing/ already has files, only migrate content that does not already exist in target.

summary: Plan-execution skill: restructure into multi-file skill with references/ (phase-1-setup, phase-2-spawn-prompts, phase-3-checkpoint, phase-4-failure-handling, phase-5-completion). Use "team member" terminology instead of "agent". Move PM + Knowledge setup to Phase 1. Lead owns all pane title setting. Checkpoint triggers stay in main SKILL.md, template in reference.

Dashboard staleness detection: show warning/critical banners on detail view and stale dots on homepage when PM stops updating status files (executing plans only)

Add /uc:setup skill — one-time machine setup (1M context env vars, agent teams, tmux, node, optional Tailscale). Writes version marker to ~/.claude/ultra/uc-setup.json for quick currency checks. Plan-execution now checks setup marker and suggests /uc:setup when missing.
Reinforce 3-digit zero-padded plan numbering in plan-enhancer skill and plan template

Docs-code sync: fix all HTML docs to match current agents/skills — fix agent tables (add project-manager, fix task-tester tools, remove phantom explore), add 4 missing skills, update workflows to 4-stage framework, add pipeline gate and PM coordination to execution docs, fix architecture claims and system overview diagram
Global singleton PM dashboard: single persistent server aggregates all projects/plans on port 3847, PM registers/deregisters plans via API, one URL for all executions
tmux-team-grid: fix Write tool error — skill only has Bash, must use cat heredoc to write script file

Add version field to plugin.json (0.1.0), add version consistency rule to CLAUDE.md

Remove Glob/Grep from Tech Knowledge agent to prevent codebase analysis; expand research brief template with verbatim doc excerpts for executors

Enable 1M context for Task Executor (opus[1m]) and Tech Knowledge (sonnet[1m]) agents
